name: Bestattungsmuseum
notes: Tiny site: no calendar/JSON-LD. Only ticketed occurrences are one public guided tour date (parsed from the JTL shop's 'Ticket für eine Führung' product configurator, linked off the shop tickets category page) and one 'Scheintot' lecture date (parsed from the Termine: list on /fuehrungen, cross-checked against the shop product for price). Expect ~1-2 records at a time; the permanent exhibition itself has no published start/end date anywhere on the site so it is intentionally not emitted.
